title: Midimaastikud / MIDI Landscapes
license: no licence notice; ETV/ERR archive, all rights reserved implied
notes: Estonia 1992 (ETV, broadcast 20 December 1992), in Estonian: composer Peeter Vähi and presenter Igor Garšnek at a Korg M1 workstation in a dark studio of plants and a chequered floor, talking about eastern thought, New Age and synthesis. W1 the MIDIMAASTIKUD title over piano keys, a hand resting on the KORG M1; W2 the studio wide under a lamp-sun, then Garšnek's introduction with his name super; W3 Vähi playing the M1 through drifting smoke, hands on the keys (music, 10 s); W4 (long) from the 'timbre choice, sound synthesis' passage, Vähi in close-up and the two men talking beside the synthesiser; W5 musicians sitting cross-legged with a gong on the stage of the Estonia concert hall (music, 10 s); W6 Vähi alone at the M1, left in the studio to play (music, 10 s). Tier B: music windows 10 s, the whole reel baked with --distort 0.5, band low for the synth.
